threshold_selection.tie_rule: max pooled Macro F1; within 1e-12 closest to0.5 then lower threshold
threshold_selection.fallback: 0.5 if too few rows/cycles or fewer than two actual classes in inner-fit/inner-validation
threshold_selection.outer_refit: Refit model on full outer training history after threshold chosen using separate inner model.
threshold_selection.existing: Same last4cycle temporal holdout; controls reuse saved inner probabilities, variants new inner fits; routes combine matching inner vectors using availability before selecting threshold.
threshold_selection.inner_shrink50: 0.5+0.5*(inner_pooled_threshold-0.5), no extra rounding or outer-label choice
threshold_selection.inner_equal_cycle: Max arithmetic mean of fixed-label [0,1] MacroF1 over all4innercycles, samegrid/tie rule; empty/insufficient total innercoverage fallsback0.5
threshold_selection.policy_scope: All4policies evaluated for all10recipes; no stream-specific cutoffs, calibration,outer-label gate choice

routing_gate: Missing if NaN or strip(signal_stream)==empty, exactly Round1 definition; present uses C2_B, missing C1_A/C1_B; no learned gate

block_hypotheses.half: Test whether reducing text representation weight changes sharedstructured/intercept andmissingrisk
block_hypotheses.double: Test whether emphasizingtext preserves presentgain or worsens conditionalrobustness
block_hypotheses.interpretation: Cfixed1, scaling text changes effective L2 penalty relative tostructured; not purecausalfeatureimportance

metrics.comparison: Report both separately on identical validation records; majority only fixed
metrics.single_class: Keep two-label macro F1 and flag; AP/balanced accuracy null
metrics.pr_auc: sklearn average_precision_score (stepwise average precision), not trapezoidal PR integration
metrics.pooled: Recompute from concatenated predictions; never average cycle/window F1 as pooled
metrics.equal_cycle: Arithmetic mean of 24 cycle Macro F1, separate from pooled
metrics.calibration: 10 fixed equal-width bins, Brier score; diagnostic only no calibration fits
metrics.impact_subgroups: Per-outer-fit 1/3 and2/3 quantiles of impact_load, same across model recipes, cutpoints recorded; no label based grouping.

subgroups: Reuse frozen Round1 subgroup masks, fit-only impactterciles, EF×stream andknown/unseen/missing; never average subgroupF1 as pooled
coefficient_analysis: Extract safe field coefficients/blocknorms/intercept fromrefits; ignored per-row logit components; verify expit(sumcomponents)==probability andtextcomponent==0 for missing. No rawvocab ormodelweights inGit.
diagnostic_before_refit: After freeze compute both fixed routes from saved Round1 probabilities, then compare fresh-refit routed vectors byte-identically; no new recipe chosen from diagnostic outcomes.
compute: 6uniquehistories:24controlouterrefits+24variantouterfits+24variantinnerfits=72freshfits. Reuse24controlinner vectors; routes do not fit estimators. W1/H12E,W4/H12L share fits.
reproduction: Prespecified end67 representative rerun:8outer+4newinnerfits=12freshfits; compare probabilities,thresholds,coefficient summaries/logit components. No full redundantrepeat.
selection_bias: Round2 is designed from Round1 outcomes on reusedcycles56-79; allcomparisons adaptive development evidence, not independentholdout/generalization guarantee. H12 overlaps primary.
